title: A new reconstruction of cropland spatial distribution in China since 1850
title_zh: 1850年以来中国耕地空间分布的新重建
authors: Erqi Xu, Xuan Gao, Luqian Li, Kewei Li
abstract: Accurately reconstructing historical cropland distribution is essential for quantifying the environmental impacts of agricultural land-use change and understanding human–environment interactions. Existing statistical inference methods provide long temporal coverage but suffer from limited spatial accuracy, while remote sensing–based approaches offer high spatial resolution but are constrained in historical depth and often exhibit area biases. To overcome these limitations, this study developed an integrated reconstruction framework and produced a yearly cropland spatial distribution dataset for China from 1850 to 2020 at a 5 km resolution. Multi-source data, including historical archives, statistical yearbooks, and national land surveys, were synthesized to construct a temporally continuous and internally consistent provincial cropland area time series through phased identification, correction, and interpolation. A dynamically weighted joint probability index was then established by combining remote sensing–derived spatial probabilities with physical suitability–based potential probabilities, enabling consistent spatial allocation of cropland before and after the remote sensing era. Results indicate that China’s cropland area experienced a “fluctuating increase–rapid expansion–continuous decline” trajectory, peaking around 1980. Cropland distribution shifted northward toward Northeast China since the early 20th century and toward Northwest China after the 1950s, while several southern and eastern provinces exhibited net cropland loss by 2020. Compared with existing datasets, the reconstructed product shows higher consistency with national land surveys and more accurately captures key spatial evolution processes. This dataset provides robust support for long-term cropland change assessment and environmental impact studies in China.
abstract_zh: 精确重建历史耕地分布对于量化农业土地利用变化的环境影响以及理解人类-环境相互作用至关重要。现有统计推断方法虽能覆盖较长时间跨度，但空间精度有限；而基于遥感的方法虽具有高空间分辨率，却在历史深度上受限且常存在面积偏差。为克服这些局限，本研究构建了一个集成重建框架，并生成了中国1850—2020年逐年、5公里分辨率的耕地空间分布数据集。通过整合历史档案、统计年鉴和全国土地调查等多源数据，采用分阶段识别、校正与插值方法，构建了时间连续且内部一致的省级耕地面积时间序列。进一步结合遥感衍生的空间概率与基于物理适宜性的潜在概率，建立了动态加权联合概率指数，实现了遥感时代前后耕地的空间一致性分配。结果表明，中国耕地面积经历了“波动增长—快速扩张—持续减少”的轨迹，约在1980年达到峰值。自20世纪初以来，耕地分布向东北地区北移，1950年代后向西北地区扩展，而多个南方和东部省份在2020年出现耕地净减少。与现有数据集相比，重建产品与全国土地调查的一致性更高，并能更准确地捕捉关键空间演变过程。该数据集为中国长期耕地变化评估及环境影响研究提供了有力支撑。

title:
Correcting Consumer Misperceptions about CO
                    <sub>2</sub>
                    Emissions
title_zh: 纠正消费者对二氧化碳排放的误解
authors: Taisuke Imai, Davide D. Pace, Peter Schwardmann, Joël J. van der Weele
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Policy makers frequently champion information provision about carbon impact on the premise that consumers are willing to mitigate their emissions but are poorly informed about how to do so. We empirically test this argument and reject it. We collect an extensive new dataset and find both large misperceptions of the carbon impact of different consumption behaviors and clear preferences for mitigation. Yet, in two separate experiments, we show that correcting beliefs has no effect on consumption in large representative samples. Our null results are well-powered and informative, as we target information for maximal impact. These results call into question the potential of correcting carbon footprint misperceptions as a tool to fight climate change.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者常以消费者愿意减少碳排放但缺乏相关知识为前提，主张提供碳影响信息。我们通过实证检验了这一论点并予以否定。通过收集大量新数据集，我们发现消费者对不同消费行为的碳影响存在严重认知偏差，同时具有明确的减排偏好。然而，在两项独立实验中，我们证明纠正认知偏差对大规模代表性样本的消费行为并无影响。我们的零结果具有充分统计效力且富有信息量，因为所提供的信息针对的是最大影响目标。这些结果对将纠正碳足迹认知偏差作为应对气候变化工具的有效性提出了质疑。

title: A second career in teaching: Exploring practices and evidence for training, supporting and retaining second-career teachers
title_zh: 第二职业教学：探索培训、支持与留住第二职业教师的实践与证据
authors: Oecd
official: 官方在线 2026-07-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Recruitment difficulties, changing career patterns and growing classroom diversity have prompted many OECD education systems to look beyond traditional initial teacher education to recruit experienced professionals from other fields. This working paper synthesises what is known about these second-career teachers (SCTs). It is structured around six questions: who they are, where they work, how they are prepared and supported, how they integrate into schools, what they contribute, and how they can be retained. Drawing on the international research literature, recent OECD data – including original analysis using a broader definition of SCT than the published TALIS measure – and policy examples from OECD systems, the paper identifies key aspects to support effective preparation, sets out the conditions that shape SCTs
abstract_zh: 招聘困难、职业模式变迁及课堂多样性日益增强，促使众多OECD教育体系超越传统职前教师教育范畴，从其他领域招募经验丰富的专业人士。本工作论文综合梳理了关于这些第二职业教师（SCTs）的现有认知，围绕六个核心问题展开：他们是谁、在何处任职、如何接受培养与支持、如何融入学校、贡献何在以及如何留任。通过借鉴国际研究文献、近期OECD数据（包括采用比已发布的TALIS指标更宽泛的SCT定义进行的原创分析）及OECD体系内的政策案例，本文识别出支持有效培养的关键要素，并阐述了塑造SCTs职业发展的条件。

title: The Effect of Mergers on Innovation
title_zh: 并购对创新的影响
authors: Kaustav Das, Tatiana Mayskaya, Arina Nikandrova
abstract: We study the effect of a merger on R&D activity in a dynamic model with uncertainty about the feasibility of innovation. The merger has three effects: It may reduce the number of follow-up innovations (cannibalization effect), increase the probability of the first game-changer innovation (appropriability effect), and bring this innovation forward in time (informational effect). The model suggests mergers are more desirable when R&D outcomes are highly uncertain, but less so when the innovation path is clearer. A surprising policy implication is that the benefit of the merger may be higher if the first and subsequent innovations are closer substitutes. (JEL D21, D83, G34, O31)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在创新可行性不确定的动态模型中，并购对研发活动的影响。并购具有三种效应：可能减少后续创新的数量（蚕食效应）、提高首个颠覆性创新的概率（占有效应），以及使该创新提前实现（信息效应）。模型表明，当研发结果高度不确定时，并购更可取；而当创新路径较为清晰时，并购的吸引力则较低。一个令人意外的政策启示是：若首次创新与后续创新之间的替代性越强，并购的收益可能越高。（JEL D21, D83, G34, O31）

title: All Roads Lead to Rome: Global Air Connectivity and Bilateral Trade
title_zh: 条条大路通罗马：全球航空连通性与双边贸易
authors: Wang, Zheng, Wang, Feicheng, Zhou, Zhuo
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using itinerary-level global air traffic data, this paper proposes a novel instrumental variable to estimate the effect of in-person interactions on bilateral trade. By exploiting exogenous variations in air connectivity that are driven by third-country connecting capacities, we show that increased air connections boost trade, especially for complex industries and new products. Online interactions appear to be a limited substitute for in-person contact. These findings confirm the role of in-person communications in reducing information-sharing barriers. Our estimation approach also provides a useful tool for evaluating the social and economic impacts of a complex transport network.
abstract_zh: 本文利用航线层面的全球航空交通数据，提出了一种新颖的工具变量，用以估计面对面交流对双边贸易的影响。通过利用由第三国中转能力驱动的航空连通性外生变化，我们发现航空联系的增加促进了贸易增长，尤其是在复杂行业和新产品领域。在线互动似乎难以有效替代面对面接触。这些发现证实了面对面交流在降低信息共享障碍方面的作用。我们的估计方法也为评估复杂交通网络的社会经济影响提供了有效工具。

title: Designing Incentives for Impatient People: An RCT Promoting Exercise to Manage Diabetes
title_zh: 为缺乏耐心者设计激励措施：一项促进运动管理糖尿病的随机对照试验
authors: Aggarwal, Shilpa, Dizon-Ross, Rebecca, Zucker, Ariel
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Many people are impatient. We introduce domain-specific discounting to a contracting model and test a prediction for how to make incentives work well when people are im- patient over effort: implement time-bundled contracts that make the payment for future effort increase in current effort. Using a randomized evaluation of an exercise incentive program among diabetics in India, we find that time-bundled contracts generate equiv- alent e ort to time-separable contracts at 15% lower cost. Moreover, they perform 30% better among individuals with above-median effort impatience. Pooled across contracts, incentives increase steps by 20% and improve blood sugar relative to a control group.
abstract_zh: 许多人缺乏耐心。我们将领域特定贴现引入契约模型，并检验一项关于如何在人们对努力缺乏耐心时有效设计激励措施的预测：实施时间捆绑契约，使未来努力的报酬随当前努力增加而递增。通过对印度糖尿病患者运动激励项目的随机评估，我们发现时间捆绑契约能以比时间可分离契约低15%的成本产生同等努力水平。此外，在努力耐心程度高于中位数的个体中，其效果提升30%。综合各类契约来看，与对照组相比，激励措施使步数增加20%，并改善血糖水平。

title: Who Gets a Family? The Consequences of Family and Congregate Care Allocation for Child Outcomes
title_zh: 谁拥有家庭？家庭与集体照料分配对儿童结局的影响
authors: Taylor, Cameron
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Hundreds of thousands of children grow up in the US foster care system every year and are at high risk of experiencing negative outcomes such as incarceration and homelessness. This paper documents how the placement of foster children into families rather than congregate care improves their outcomes using the exits of other children from families as an instrument for their placement setting. Policies that change which children are matched to families can achieve a large percentage of the gains from policies that add families to the foster care system due to heterogeneity in treatment effects.
abstract_zh: 每年有数十万儿童在美国寄养系统中成长，他们面临监禁、无家可归等负面结果的高风险。本文利用其他儿童离开家庭作为其安置环境的工具变量，记录了将寄养儿童安置于家庭而非集体照料机构如何改善其结局。由于处理效应的异质性，改变儿童与家庭匹配方式的政策，能够实现通过向寄养系统增加家庭的政策所带来收益的很大一部分。

title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
title_zh: 技能替代型技术与底层收入不平等
authors: Oren Danieli
abstract: Abstract I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: 1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, 2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and 3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出了一种技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代了常规任务中的技能使用，这与标准RBTC模型（假设技术替代工人本身）形成对比。SR-RBTC模型解释了与标准RBTC模型不一致的三个关键趋势：1）尽管常规职业中的工人分散于整个工资分布下半部分，但为何中位数工资却出现下降；2）为何在技术变革持续进行的情况下，中位数工资停止下降；3）为何常规职业工人的平均工资未出现显著下降。基于该模型，我推导出两个可检验的新预测：常规职业中技能回报率下降以及技能水平下降。通过交互固定效应模型，我验证了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违反了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入了一种“偏度分解”方法，证明SR-RBTC是下半部分工资不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。

title: Counteracting the Impact of Societal Aging on Income Inequality : A Case Study of Malaysia
title_zh: 应对社会老龄化对收入不平等的影响：马来西亚案例研究
authors: World Bank
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyzes the effect of societal aging on income inequality in Malaysia, to date and in the coming decades. The study starts from the hypothesis that, all things equal, aging exerts upward pressure on inequality (Deaton and Paxson (1994, 1995)). Drawing on nationally representative household survey data over the past two decades, the study finds evidence in support of this hypothesis in Malaysia. This picture becomes even sharper when projecting inequality levels for the years when Malaysia is forecast to reach aged (2045) and super-aged (2056) status. Estimates show that between 2022 and 2056, overall inequality of individual incomes could rise by as much as 13 percent due to aging. The analysis then demonstrates that expansion of a social pension system would attenuate this projected rise in inequality. The paper also undertakes counterfactual exercises simulating the expansion of an old age social pension with various design variants. The variants considered would expand existing social transfers for older people. Given the public revenue and spending patterns in Malaysia, some of these design options are potentially manageable from a fiscal perspective. The analysis suggests that, relative to the observed situation in 2022, wider coverage of social pensions could have resulted in lower inequality in household per capita income among older individuals (by 12–26 percent), thereby lowering overall inequality (by 4-9 percent). This inequality-reducing effect of social pensions becomes even more marked when projecting estimates of inequality for 2045 and 2056. Moreover, the findings show that expanded pensions would have resulted in a lower headcount poverty rate in 2022 by 1.3–4.2 percentage points among the 60+ population, and by 0.5–1.9 points among the overall population.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了马来西亚当前及未来数十年人口老龄化对收入不平等的影响。研究基于"在其他条件不变的情况下，老龄化会加剧不平等压力"这一假设（Deaton & Paxson, 1994, 1995）。通过利用过去二十年间具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据，本研究发现马来西亚的数据支持该假设。当预测马来西亚达到"老龄化社会"（2045年）和"超老龄化社会"（2056年）年份的不平等水平时，这一趋势更为显著。估算显示，2022年至2056年间，仅因老龄化因素，个人收入总体不平等程度可能上升高达13%。进一步分析表明，扩大社会养老金体系将缓解这一预期中的不平等加剧趋势。本文还开展了反事实模拟，考察不同设计方案的老年社会养老金扩面效果。所考虑的方案将扩大现有针对老年人的社会转移支付。基于马来西亚公共收入与支出模式，部分设计方案在财政层面具有潜在可行性。分析表明，相较于2022年观测到的实际情况，扩大社会养老金覆盖率可使老年人家庭人均收入不平等程度降低12%-26%，进而使总体不平等程度下降4%-9%。当对2045年和2056年的不平等水平进行预测时，社会养老金的这种不平等缓解效应更为显著。此外，研究结果显示，扩大养老金覆盖可使2022年60岁以上人口贫困发生率降低1.3-4.2个百分点，总人口贫困发生率降低0.5-1.9个百分点。

title: Information alliance in common agency
title_zh: 共同代理中的信息联盟
authors: Rafael Costa Lima, Humberto Moreira, Alexander Rodivilov, Dongsoo Shin
abstract: We study an agency model with two independent projects each of which is owned by a principal. Under exclusive agency, each principal uses a different agent, whereas under common agency, all principals use the same agent. A project’s outcome depends on the agent’s hidden effort. We show that, even in the absence of physical linkages between the projects, a principal benefits from providing information on her project outcome to the other principal under common agency (rather than benefiting from receiving the information ), whereas no such benefits arise under exclusive agency. That is, under common agency, an information sharing principal can take advantage of the other principal’s using the shared information. As a result, sharing information becomes each principal’s dominant strategy, provided that the other principal uses the shared information in a Pareto-optimal way. We show that using a common agent is optimal when information can be shared.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个独立项目的委托代理模型，每个项目由一位委托人所有。在独家代理模式下，每位委托人雇佣不同的代理人；而在共同代理模式下，所有委托人雇佣同一代理人。项目的产出取决于代理人的隐性努力。研究表明，即使项目之间不存在物理关联，在共同代理模式下，委托人通过向另一位委托人提供自身项目结果的信息（而非接收信息）能够获益，而这种收益在独家代理模式下并不存在。也就是说，在共同代理模式下，共享信息的委托人可以利用另一位委托人对共享信息的使用。因此，只要另一位委托人以帕累托最优方式使用共享信息，信息共享将成为每位委托人的占优策略。我们证明，当信息可以共享时，使用共同代理人是最优选择。

title: Repurposing Agricultural Budgets With Multiple Objectives and Fiscal Constraints: A Multicriteria Decision‐Making Policy Tool Applied to Sub‐Saharan African Countries
title_zh: 多重目标与财政约束下的农业预算重新配置：应用于撒哈拉以南非洲国家的多准则决策政策工具
authors: Marco V. Sánchez, Martín Cicowiez, Lucia Battaglia, Valentina Pernechele
abstract: Repurposing agricultural public resources toward higher‐return incentives and investments can help transform agri‐food systems. This is important for low‐income countries, especially in sub‐Saharan Africa, where limited budgets restrict options for boosting agricultural spending. We demonstrate how, within a tight budget envelope, opportunities exist to achieve better agricultural transformation outcomes. To this end, we developed the policy optimization modelling tool, PolOpT, which combines a multicriteria decision‐making technique and a recursive‐dynamic computable general equilibrium model. We applied it with datasets for six sub‐Saharan African countries, including hundreds of estimated parameters that transmit the effect of policy measures onto agricultural productivity. The approach demonstrates that reallocating agricultural public expenditure across policy measures in these countries can potentially boost agri‐food output by several percentage points, create almost a million off‐farm jobs in rural areas, lift almost 3 million people out of poverty and allow 16 million people more to afford a healthy diet—all without extra funding.
abstract_zh: 将农业公共资源重新配置到更高回报的激励措施和投资领域，有助于推动农业食品体系转型。这对低收入国家尤为重要，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，这些国家有限的预算制约了农业支出增长的选择空间。我们证明，在预算约束范围内，仍存在实现更优农业转型成果的机遇。为此，我们开发了政策优化建模工具PolOpT，该工具融合了多准则决策技术与递归动态可计算一般均衡模型。我们利用六个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的数据集（包含数百个反映政策措施对农业生产率传导效应的估计参数）进行了应用分析。研究结果表明，在这些国家间重新配置农业公共支出，可在不增加额外资金的情况下，使农业食品产出提升数个百分点，在农村地区创造近百万非农就业岗位，帮助近300万人摆脱贫困，并使1600万人能够负担健康膳食。
